comparison.objective: Refit a delta robot's sprung parallel-rod pair onto four ball studs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual spreading of a spring-loaded part and multi-point snap-on alignment.
comparison.success_condition: All four cups are captured on their balls without dropping or overstretching, then released.
comparison.reason: Both are robot-maintenance tasks, but this tests elastic spreading and four-point snap attachment rather than screw adjustment, jam-nut countertorque, and retained motion.
